A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same Mod-Adapter study with complete, readable text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–E. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish that pages 2–14 are identical; page 1 differs only in affiliation and version/date text.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark evaluations, a user study, and component ablations in Tables 1–3, alongside qualitative results and appendix expert-routing analysis.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark, user-study, ablation, qualitative, and expert-routing results reported in v1.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same modulation adapter, vision-language cross-attention, k-means MoE routing, VLM-guided pretraining, training objectives, and inference procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use MVImgNet, AFHQ, and synthetic abstract-concept training data, with the same DreamBench/DreamBench-Abs coverage and single- and multi-concept personalization tasks.

E2.justification: The corresponding quantitative, qualitative, and user-study comparisons retain Emu2, MIP-Adapter, MS-Diffusion, and TokenVerse. No comparator is added, removed, or revised.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendix B retain identical training budgets, model configurations, benchmark construction, CP/PF/CP·PF/CLIP-T metrics, and user-study procedures, including the reported 32 participants.

E4.justification: Section 4.3 retains the same pretraining, vision-language attention, MoE, and routing ablations. Appendix D preserves the same expert-utilization analysis, and the qualitative examples are unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical, including user-rating averaging. Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or formal significance tests.

E6.justification: All entries in Tables 1–3 and all qualitative and appendix results are unchanged. For example, Table 1 reports the same Mod-Adapter CP·PF scores of 0.62 for multi-concept and 0.54 for single-concept personalization.

T1.justification: Equations 1–6 and their mathematical explanations are identical. Neither version adds or removes formal assumptions, propositions, proofs, or derivations.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about tuning-free object and abstract-concept personalization, the Mod-Adapter components, DreamBench-Abs, and state-of-the-art performance.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and mechanism explanations are unchanged. Appendix A retains the limitations concerning repeated concept names and personalization of more than three concepts; Appendix C retains the same broader-impact discussion.

D1.justification: Implementation and access information are identical, including FLUX.1-dev, Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, optimizer settings, training steps, eight A800 GPUs, user-study details, and the project-page address.

R1.justification: Section 2 and all 43 references are unchanged, as is the positioning relative to TokenVerse, tuning-free personalization methods, and existing adapters.

P1.justification: The first affiliation changes from Sun Yat-sen University to Gezhi Al, Guangzhou, and the arXiv version/date stamp is updated. The remaining language, terminology, and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–8 and Tables 1–3 retain identical content, captions, formatting, and placement. The affiliation and version/date text updates introduce no substantive layout change.

improvement.justification: The revision changes only affiliation and version/date text. The scientific content, empirical evidence, explanations, limitations, reproducibility information, and presentation otherwise remain identical, including the appendices, establishing no meaningful net difference in overall paper quality.
